_comment: The manifest of @abap2ui5/embed-control - the abap2UI5 frontend (app/webapp:
the UI5 component z2ui5 and the control z2ui5.embed.Container) as an npm package. tools/pack-frontend.mjs copies it into a STAGING directory
outside the checkout, sets the version to the framework's, records the commit
under `abap2ui5`, drops this comment and packs there. The version below is
deliberately a placeholder: `npm run check:version` holds the framework's
version in package.json and z2ui5_if_app=>version - not here.
name: @abap2ui5/embed-control
description: Run abap2UI5 apps inside any UI5 app: the control z2ui5.embed.Container and the abap2UI5 frontend it wraps (the UI5 component z2ui5, with its Component-preload.js), as a UI5 tooling project of type module.
